Chhattisgarh School Education Dept Agrees to Hold TET Exam

The School Education Department in Chhattisgarh has agreed to organize the Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) exam, bringing relief to teachers in the state. The department is also considering increasing administrative responsibilities within its offices and initiating the creation of new positions.
